newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai's Tamagotchi sales to top 10 million - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bandai's Tamagotchi sales to top 10 million - paper.

text.p: Sales of Bandai Co Ltd's virtual pet toy Tamagotchi are expected to reach 10 million on Tuesday, the business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported.

The toy, which displays a bird-like image on the screen of an egg-shaped key-ring device and simulates the life cycle of a pet, was introduced in Japan last November and quickly caught on among schoolgirls.
The toy was launched in the U.S. and European markets earlier this month.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.
